svg.text: Inside the Clausal compiler: one Gherkin sentence, dual formal & executable targets
Zero LLM guesswork and zero raw Prop holes—the compiler assembles typed Clausebook slots or refuses.
1. INPUT: CANONICAL CLAUSAL SENTENCE IN features/*.feature (100% VALID GHERKIN)
• Slot-checks grammar & algebraic sorts (Op, Measure, Cond)
• Enforces fail-closed Op.HoldsAt (no panic / silent drop)
• Emits dual ASTs with zero raw Prop escape hatches
+ Generates .sat non-vacuity & reading <-> stmt link checks
+ Proved over Aeneas-extracted pure Lean code model
+ Runs immediately via standard cargo test (no Lean needed)
+ Emits bounded Kani harnesses & replays counterexamples
Result: product/policy owners read row 1; cargo test executes 3B in seconds; Lean's kernel proves 3A for every input.
